title: iRacing Track Guide Oulton Park | Skip Barber | 1:50.828

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake to first gear at banners on left
corners.line: turn in, apex at banner, exit on dirt
corners.mistakes: do not run wide, harsh off track

corners.label: T2
corners.mistakes: Hit the kerb on the inside

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: Brake for turn three, down to third gear
corners.line: Wide entry, late apex, use inside curbing
corners.mistakes: Use no more than the red and white curbing on the right

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: Start braking for the hairpin, second gear, cold tires maybe first.
corners.line: Lay the apex and get on power as soon as possible.
corners.exit: Better exit benefits the upcoming straight.
corners.mistakes: Don't run too far wide, curb crests onto grass.

corners.label: T6
corners.line: Keep it on the left side for the straight as much as possible.
corners.mistakes: Not really a corner, avoid running wide on left.

corners.label: T8
corners.braking: Break down into second gear at cement dust white marking.
corners.line: Straight line it as much as possible.
corners.exit: Cut it as much as possible.
corners.mistakes: Don't run wide on left, off track and slow down.

corners.braking: braking board 50 meters, down to first gear
corners.exit: keep it on throttle, watch for pothole
corners.mistakes: run wide, hit off track and slowdown

corners.braking: tap brakes, down to third gear
corners.line: clip the apex on the inside
corners.mistakes: don't bother about the first apex, run wide over the crest

corners.braking: stand on the brakes, down to second gear

general_tips: keep rear end in check on skippy
Careful of overtaking on left or right over the crest
Avoid running wide on the left side.
keep it to the left-hand side to avoid the kink
keep in fourth gear, fifth if following someone
